column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT mc.account_no AS "CustomerID", TO_CHAR(msa.created_on_utc, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "Date Opened", mc.display_name AS "Account Name", msa.account_no AS "Account No", coalesce(trxn.running_balance_derived,0) AS "Account Balance", mcv.code_value AS "Account Tier", CONCAT(msp."name", ' ', msp.currency_code) AS "Account Type", rev.enum_value AS "Account Status", CONCAT(ma.firstname, ' ', ma.lastname) AS "Account Opened By", ii."ID Number" AS "BVN", mc.mobile_no AS "Mobile", mc.email_address AS "Email", CONCAT(mad.address_line_1, ' ', mad.address_line_2, ' ', mad.city) AS "Address", ms.display_name AS "Account Officer" FROM m_savings_account msa JOIN m_client mc ON mc.id = msa.client_id JOIN m_savings_product msp ON msa.product_id = msp.id LEFT JOIN r_enum_value rev ON rev.enum_id = msa.status_enum AND rev.enum_name = 'status_enum' LEFT JOIN m_appuser ma ON ma.id = msa.created_by LEFT JOIN m_code_value mcv ON mc.client_classification_cv_id = mcv.id LEFT JOIN m_client_address mca ON mc.id = mca.client_id AND mca.address_type_id = 18 LEFT JOIN m_address mad ON mad.id = mca.address_id LEFT JOIN m_staff ms ON msa.field_officer_id = ms.id LEFT JOIN "Identity Information" ii ON ii.client_id = mc.id AND ii."Identity Types_cd_Identity Type" = (SELECT id FROM m_code_value mcvb WHERE mcvb.code_id = (SELECT id FROM m_code WHERE code_name = 'Identity Types') AND mcvb.code_value = 'BVN') LEFT JOIN ( SELECT savings_account_id, MAX(id) AS latest_transaction_id FROM m_savings_account_transaction msat WHERE msat.is_reversed = FALSE AND msat.transaction_date <= '${endDate}' AND msat.transaction_type_enum IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 18, 22, 23, 24) GROUP BY savings_account_id ) latest_trxn ON msa.id = latest_trxn.savings_account_id LEFT JOIN m_savings_account_transaction trxn ON trxn.id = latest_trxn.latest_transaction_id WHERE (msa.product_id = ${savingsProductId} OR -1 = ${savingsProductId}) ORDER BY mc.display_name

delete.where: report_id = (SELECT id FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Account Balance') AND report_parameter_name = 'startDate'
